test_cases.expected_result: Generated implementation preserves the grounded rule.
test_cases.test_name: Calculate the reorder quantity as the difference between the reorder level and the on-hand quantity.

generation_notes: Generated scenarios cover happy path, negative cases, boundary conditions, and null handling for the inventory reorder process.

scenarios.description: An inventory item with on-hand quantity less than reorder level should be selected and reorder quantity calculated.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The item should be selected for reorder with a reorder quantity of 50.
scenarios.title: Basic Reorder Calculation

scenarios.description: An inventory item with on-hand quantity equal to reorder level should not be selected for reorder.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The item should not be selected for reorder.
scenarios.title: No Reorder Needed

scenarios.description: An inventory item with on-hand quantity greater than reorder level should not be selected for reorder.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The item should not be selected for reorder.
scenarios.title: Excess Inventory

scenarios.description: An inventory item with zero on-hand quantity should be selected for reorder.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The item should be selected for reorder with a reorder quantity of 50.
scenarios.title: Boundary Condition at Zero

scenarios.description: An inventory item with null on-hand quantity should not be selected for reorder.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The item should not be selected for reorder due to null on-hand quantity.
scenarios.title: Null Handling for On-Hand Quantity
